Scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a full noun phrase rather than using only his name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
Run 2: 试一试很多种植物：尝一尝各种植物，尝 is the verb for tasting plants or food; 试一试 is less suitable here because it usually means trying an action, method, or object out. [rule: none]
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 神农出去：一个叫神农的人出去，at this character’s first mention, introduce the name together with a full noun phrase so the reader knows who the character is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]

output.reason: Runs 1 and 3 address introducing 神农 as a new character, while Run 2 changes 试一试 to 尝一尝.
